timing: Specified before inspecting any v3 trait-environment coefficient. V2 and v3 image-only technical results are already known; not preregistered.
target: For each response coordinate, jointly fit taxon intercepts, the same conditional environmental predictors, shared nuisance effects, and taxon-specific deviations from a slope hypermean. Keep every supplied taxon, including locally rank-deficient and single-observation taxa.
model: y_ij = a_i + x_ij^T(mu + b_i) + nuisance_ij^T gamma + epsilon_ij. Within-taxon centering analytically removes fixed intercepts. b_i ~ N(0, sigma^2 diag(lambda)), lambda>=0; independent homoskedastic epsilon is the WORKING likelihood, not the final spatial uncertainty claim.
computational_realization: One-stage Gaussian likelihood is used so an unestimable local slope need not be invented or discarded before pooling. All taxon slope and shared-nuisance columns are fitted jointly. For a full-rank homoskedastic design this is the Gaussian hierarchy represented by joint slope estimates with their complete sampling covariance; do not feed only diagonal HC3 variances to this implementation. The earlier joint HC3 solver remains an independent-error algebra reference.
heterogeneity_structure: A diagonal random-slope covariance in the fixed, common predictor coordinates is an explicit working-model restriction inherited from coordinate-wise heterogeneity, not a claim that ecological processes are independent. Predictor conditional dependence and full cross-taxon prediction-error covariance from shared fixed effects are retained. Cross-response inference requires joint resampling; these coordinate fits do not provide a module test on their own.
rank: Use each local centered environmental rank only as an information annotation. Zero local information produces a model-based pooled prediction, not an independently estimable taxon slope. Fail if the common environmental effects are globally aliased with each other or the shared nuisance span; compress only redundant nuisance columns, never silently drop an exposure.
reml: Profile residual scale and fixed effects. Optimize nonnegative variance ratios in log1p coordinates with analytic gradients and four deterministic starts at lambda 0, 0.1, 1 and 10. Record all attempts. A solution at the upper numerical search bound or an unresolved lower objective in a failed attempt is not accepted. Numerical stationarity is not a proof of global optimality.
conditional_uncertainty: Report fixed-effect covariance and full joint empirical-Bayes slope prediction-error covariance conditional on fitted variance components. Include hypermean/nuisance estimation uncertainty: at tau=0 taxon predictions share the nonzero hypermean uncertainty. Do not label these as calibrated spatial intervals or full parameter-uncertainty posterior distributions.
next_inference_gate: Joint multiresponse statistics, whole-source-component preserving 2-degree/5-degree resampling, matched-support among-minus-within covariance, measurement-formulation envelopes and null/coverage simulations remain required before ecological probabilities or conclusions.
